insight: Backed by Stephen Wolfram's first-ever startup investment; founded in 2024 by an ex-Google X trio.
name: TwinMind
tagline: An always-on AI second brain that captures and remembers everything you hear.
description: TwinMind runs in the background on your phone, continuously listening to meetings, lectures, and conversations to build a private, searchable memory you can query in plain language. It transcribes on-device, generates notes, to-dos, and daily digests, and answers questions across everything it has heard. The proprietary Ear-3 speech model handles 140+ languages, and audio is processed locally for privacy, with cloud AI chat in the paid tiers.

modelSupport.notes: Own Ear-3 speech model for transcription; paid tiers add ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude for chat.

edge: Transcribes meetings and conversations continuously for up to 17 hours on-device in 140+ languages, building a searchable personal memory.

references.title: Ex-Google X trio wants their AI to be your second brain
